This is my own personal build distribution for BlueBubbles, containg a number of features, fixes, and polishes for testing.

Many of these changes can be found as pending PRs upstream, or will be submitted as PRs eventually.

This exists mainly for the purpose of quickly distributing builds to all the platforms I use (android, windows, and kubuntu) so I can daily-drive the contributions.
